name: Mix a Brainrot
desc:
🧪 MIX TWO BRAINROTS = 🧬 NEW UNIQUE BRAINROT!

💤 EGGS HATCH & MONEY STACKS WHILE YOU SLEEP! 🤑

🥚 Hatch — Open eggs to discover Brainrots from common to insanely rare.
🌟 Mutate — Some mixes unlock special mutated forms worth even more!
🍗 Feed & Grow — Level up your Brainrots to boost earnings and climb the leaderboard.
🤝 Trade — Swap with players or NPCs to find the perfect parts for your next mix.
💻 Play Anywhere — PC, Mobile, Tablet & Console. Full Controller Support!

📘 15,625 Possible Brainrots, GOOD LUCK!

⚠️ Always trade using the in-game trade system. Join the community to share mix recipes and flex your mutations!
